# Omnitro

> Portable, tool-agnostic Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for biomedical research, bioinformatics, statistics, scientific writing and reproducible analysis. Start with AGENTS.md.

## Entry points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): operating rules and skill routing
- [INDEX.md](INDEX.md): human-readable catalog
- [skills-index.json](skills-index.json): machine-readable catalog

## Core research workflow

- [literature-review](skills/literature-review/SKILL.md): Use when the user asks to find, summarize, compare, or synthesize biomedical or clinical research evidence — e.g. "what does the evidence say about", "summariz…
- [study-design](skills/study-design/SKILL.md): Use when the user asks to design, plan, or critique a biomedical or clinical study — e.g. "design an experiment to test", "plan a study on", "what study design…
- [data-analysis](skills/data-analysis/SKILL.md): Use when the user asks to analyze, interpret, or write code for biomedical or clinical data — e.g. "analyze this dataset", "what statistical test should I use"…
- [research-ideation](specialized-skills/research-ideation/SKILL.md): Generate and assess biomedical research ideas, hypotheses, unanswered questions, and project directions
- [search-strategy](specialized-skills/search-strategy/SKILL.md): Use to design reproducible literature and database searches: PICO framing, keyword and controlled vocabulary (MeSH) selection, Boolean logic, database choice,…

## Statistics and evidence

- [statistical-power](specialized-skills/statistical-power/SKILL.md): Use when the user asks about sample size, statistical power, minimum detectable effect, number of replicates, or whether a study or experiment is underpowered

- [survival-analysis](specialized-skills/survival-analysis/SKILL.md): Use for time-to-event analysis: Kaplan-Meier curves, log-rank tests, Cox proportional hazards models, hazard ratios, censoring, competing risks, overall or pro…
- [causal-inference](specialized-skills/causal-inference/SKILL.md): Use when the user asks whether an exposure or treatment causes an outcome using observational data: confounding, DAGs, propensity scores, inverse probability w…
- [meta-analysis](specialized-skills/meta-analysis/SKILL.md): Use when the user wants to plan, run, critique, or interpret a systematic review or meta-analysis: pooling effect sizes, odds ratios, risk ratios, hazard ratio…
- [evidence-appraisal](specialized-skills/evidence-appraisal/SKILL.md): Use when the user asks how reliable, biased, or certain a body of evidence or an individual study is: risk of bias, study quality, GRADE, certainty of evidence…
- [reporting-guidelines](specialized-skills/reporting-guidelines/SKILL.md): Use when preparing, checking, or reviewing a manuscript, protocol, or study report against a reporting guideline or checklist: CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, STARD,…
- [biomedical-machine-learning](specialized-skills/biomedical-machine-learning/SKILL.md): Use when building, reviewing, or interpreting machine-learning or deep-learning models on biomedical data: classifiers, prognostic or diagnostic prediction, bi…
- [research-model-selection](specialized-skills/research-model-selection/SKILL.md): Find, compare, or assess AI models and datasets for biomedical research, including Hugging Face model cards, datasets, model evaluation, and responsible resear…

- [genomics-variants](specialized-skills/genomics-variants/SKILL.md): Analyze or interpret genomic variants, VCF files, variant annotations, genome builds, allele frequencies, and variant prioritization for research
- [rna-seq-analysis](specialized-skills/rna-seq-analysis/SKILL.md): Plan or review bulk RNA-seq analysis, gene expression counts, differential expression, sample quality control, batch effects, and functional interpretation
- [chip-atac-seq](specialized-skills/chip-atac-seq/SKILL.md): Use for ChIP-seq, CUT&RUN, CUT&Tag, and ATAC-seq analysis: read QC, FRiP, fragment size, TSS enrichment, peak calling, replicate reproducibility, blacklist reg…
- [gwas-statistical-genetics](specialized-skills/gwas-statistical-genetics/SKILL.md): Use for genome-wide association studies and statistical genetics: sample and variant QC, population stratification, mixed models, REGENIE, SAIGE, PLINK, summar…
- [crispr-screen-analysis](specialized-skills/crispr-screen-analysis/SKILL.md): Use for analysis and interpretation of pooled CRISPR knockout, CRISPRi, or CRISPRa screens and Perturb-seq: guide count QC, library coverage, replicate correla…
- [phylogenetics](specialized-skills/phylogenetics/SKILL.md): Use for evolutionary and sequence-comparison analysis: multiple sequence alignment, alignment trimming, substitution model selection, maximum likelihood or Bay…
